# Technext

> > Technext is an award-winning Bangladesh-based software development company offering staff augmentation, full-stack web/mobile development, and UI/UX design services for SMBs and startups globally.

Founded in 2012, Technext has delivered 540+ projects for 290+ clients across the USA, Canada, and UK. The company specializes in modern tech stacks including React, Node.js, TypeScript, and AI integration, with a proven track record through detailed case studies and client testimonials.
